changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant task descriptors and normalized model names. Kept only the core abstractive OpenIE task. Consolidated datasets by removing duplicate/redundant mentions.
Simplified metric names to base forms and removed descriptive annotations. Combined semantic entailment metrics into their core names without qualifiers.

overall_notes: Paper focuses on abstractive OpenIE as a text generation task. Uses both traditional lexical metrics (CaRB, ROUGE) and proposes new semantic entailment metrics. All evaluations are automatic, no human or LLM evaluations conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of redundant items.
